basics.name: Mohammed Barakat
basics.label: PhD Student, Mechanical Engineering @ Carnegie Mellon University
basics.summary: Incoming PhD student in Mechanical Engineering at Carnegie Mellon University. B.S. Mechanical Engineering from the University of Texas at Tyler (GPA 3.95, President's List). Experience in computational modeling, machine learning for simulation, embedded systems, and AI-driven engineering design.

work.name: Texas A&M University, Department of Materials Science and Engineering
work.summary: NSF Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU) studying nanoscale deformation in silicon using machine-learning-enhanced molecular dynamics simulation.
highlights: Machine-learning-enhanced MD simulation of nanoscale silicon deformation
Nanostructure modeling and analysis using LAMMPS, OVITO, Atomsk, and Wulffpack
Presented project poster at Texas A&M University

work.name: University of Texas at Tyler, College of Engineering
work.summary: Assisted faculty and students in the engineering lab. Reverse-engineered industrial devices via CAD.
highlights: Reverse-engineered industrial devices using SolidWorks and Autodesk Inventor
Supported lab operations and student projects

work.name: University of Texas at Tyler, College of Engineering
work.summary: Machine learning research across carbon sequestration, subsurface hydrogen storage, autonomous embedded systems, and non-invasive ultrasound brain imaging.
highlights: Applied machine learning to CO2 sequestration and subsurface hydrogen storage
Developed a fully autonomous ANN within a portable Arduino desalination system
Developed a novel ultrasound method for non-invasive brain scanning toward tumor identification and future removal
Extracted acoustic properties of biological media and assigned them via color segmentation

work.name: University of Texas at Tyler
work.summary: Provided technical support to students, faculty, and staff across university systems and hardware.

awards.title: Outstanding Student in College of Engineering

publications.name: AI Ethical Practices in Commercial Engineering Organizations
publications.summary: Examines ethical frameworks and best practices for deploying artificial intelligence in commercial mechanical engineering contexts.

projects.name: MD Simulation with Machine-Learned Potentials
projects.summary: NSF O-REU at Texas A&M University: nanoscale deformation in silicon using molecular dynamics driven by machine-learned interatomic potentials.
highlights: Poster presented at Texas A&M University

projects.name: NICU Sensory Bonding Device
projects.summary: Senior Design capstone project. Team lead and software lead on a device that simulates a mother's presence inside a NICU incubator via sound, scent, and haptic touch, remotely activated through a Wi-Fi-connected mobile app.
highlights: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W embedded system driving sound, scent, and haptic outputs
Wi-Fi-connected mobile app for remote activation

projects.name: ANN-Integrated Desalination System
projects.summary: Developed an Arduino-based desalination system integrated with an artificial neural network for process optimization.

volunteer.organization: American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME), University of Texas at Tyler Student Section
